  + [Egypt](/wiki/Egypt "Egypt") announces the discovery of [Thutmose II](/wiki/Thutmose_II "Thutmose II")'s [tomb](/wiki/Tomb_of_Thutmose_II "Tomb of Thutmose II") by a joint British-Egyptian team, the first royal tomb to be discovered since [Tutankhamun](/wiki/Tutankhamun "Tutankhamun")'s in 1922. It is the 15th and final [pharaoh](/wiki/Pharaoh "Pharaoh") tomb from the [Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt](/wiki/Eighteenth_Dynasty_of_Egypt "Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt") to have been found by archeologists.[[71]](#cite_note-71)[[72]](#cite_note-72)[[a]](#cite_note-73)
* [February 19](/wiki/February_19 "February 19") – [Croatia](/wiki/Croatia "Croatia") completes the process of joining the [European Economic Area](/wiki/European_Economic_Area "European Economic Area").[[73]](#cite_note-74)
* [February 23](/wiki/February_23 "February 23") – [2025 German federal election](/wiki/2025_German_federal_election "2025 German federal election"): After being pushed forward as a result of the [2024 German government crisis](/wiki/2024_German_government_crisis "2024 German government crisis"), the centre-right [CDU/CSU](/wiki/CDU/CSU "CDU/CSU") becomes the largest party, with big gains from the far-right [AfD](/wiki/Alternative_for_Germany "Alternative for Germany"), resulting in a second-place finish.[[74]](#cite_note-75)
* [February 25](/wiki/February_25 "February 25") – An [Antonov An-26](/wiki/Antonov_An-26 "Antonov An-26") of the [Sudanese Air Force](/wiki/Sudanese_Air_Force "Sudanese Air Force") [crashes](/wiki/2025_Sudanese_Air_Force_Antonov_An-26_crash "2025 Sudanese Air Force Antonov An-26 crash") in a residential area, near the [Wadi Seidna Air Base](/wiki/Wadi_Seidna_Air_Base "Wadi Seidna Air Base"). All 17 occupants onboard and 29 people on the ground died.[[75]](#cite_note-76)
* [February 28](/wiki/February_28 "February 28") – [A meeting](/wiki/2025_Trump%E2%80%93Zelenskyy_meeting "2025 Trump–Zelenskyy meeting") between [U.S. president](/wiki/President_of_the_United_States "President of the United States") [Donald Trump](/wiki/Donald_Trump "Donald Trump") and [Ukrainian president](/wiki/President_of_Ukraine "President of Ukraine") [Volodymyr Zelenskyy](/wiki/Volodymyr_Zelenskyy "Volodymyr Zelenskyy") takes place at the [White House](/wiki/White_House "White House"). Trump and [V.P.](/wiki/Vice_President_of_the_United_States "Vice President of the United States") [JD Vance](/wiki/JD_Vance "JD Vance") sharply criticise Zelenskyy, raising questions about support for [Ukraine](/wiki/Ukraine "Ukraine"), a proposed end to the [war](/wiki/Russo-Ukrainian_war "Russo-Ukrainian war"), and the country's future in general.[[76]](#cite_note-77)

### March

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: March")]

* [March 2](/wiki/March_2 "March 2") – [Firefly Aerospace](/wiki/Firefly_Aerospace "Firefly Aerospace") becomes the first commercial company to successfully [land](/wiki/Moon_landing "Moon landing") on the Moon with no technical issues, with its [Blue Ghost Mission 1](/wiki/Blue_Ghost_Mission_1 "Blue Ghost Mission 1").[[77]](#cite_note-78)[[78]](#cite_note-79)
* [March 3](/wiki/March_3 "March 3") – The [Trump administration](/wiki/Second_presidency_of_Donald_Trump "Second presidency of Donald Trump") pauses [military aid to Ukraine](/wiki/List_of_military_aid_to_Ukraine_during_the_Russo-Ukrainian_war "List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian war"), following the [Oval Office meeting](/wiki/2025_Trump%E2%80%93Zelenskyy_meeting "2025 Trump–Zelenskyy meeting") with [Zelenskyy](/wiki/Volodymyr_Zelenskyy "Volodymyr Zelenskyy") the previous week.[[79]](#cite_note-80)
* [March 4](/wiki/March_4 "March 4") – [Colossal Biosciences](/wiki/Colossal_Biosciences "Colossal Biosciences") creates [woolly mice](/wiki/Woolly_mouse "Woolly mouse") as part of [de-extinction efforts for the woolly mammoth](/wiki/Revival_of_the_woolly_mammoth "Revival of the woolly mammoth").[[80]](#cite_note-81)[[b]](#cite_note-82)
* [March 5](/wiki/March_5 "March 5") – [Sudan](/wiki/Sudan "Sudan") files an application against the [United Arab Emirates](/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates "United Arab Emirates") before the [International Court of Justice](/wiki/International_Court_of_Justice "International Court of Justice"), alleging violations of the [Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide](/wiki/Convention_on_the_Prevention_and_Punishment_of_the_Crime_of_Genocide "Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide") by the UAE through its support for the [RSF](/wiki/Rapid_Support_Forces "Rapid Support Forces"), which is responsible for the [genocide in Darfur](/wiki/Masalit_massacres_(2023%E2%80%93present) "Masalit massacres (2023–present)").[[81]](#cite_note-83)
* [March 8](/wiki/March_8 "March 8") – More than 1,000 people, including civilians, are reported [killed in a crackdown](/wiki/2025_massacres_of_Syrian_Alawites "2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites") by [Syrian transitional government](/wiki/Syrian_caretaker_government "Syrian caretaker government") security forces in the [Alawite](/wiki/Alawites "Alawites") region, described as the country's worst violence for years.[[82]](#cite_note-84)[[83]](#cite_note-85)[[84]](#cite_note-86)
* [March 8](/wiki/March_8 "March 8")–[17](/wiki/March_17 "March 17") – The [2025 Special Olympics World Winter Games](/wiki/2025_Special_Olympics_World_Winter_Games "2025 Special Olympics World Winter Games") are held in [Turin](/wiki/Turin "Turin"), Italy.[[85]](#cite_note-87)
* [March 11](/wiki/March_11 "March 11")
  + The former [President of the Philippines](/wiki/President_of_the_Philippines "President of the Philippines"), [Rodrigo Duterte](/wiki/Rodrigo_Duterte "Rodrigo Duterte"), is [arrested](/wiki/Arrest_of_Rodrigo_Duterte "Arrest of Rodrigo Duterte") in the [Philippines](/wiki/Philippines "Philippines") after being served an [arrest warrant](/wiki/International_Criminal_Court_investigation_in_the_Philippines "International Criminal Court investigation in the Philippines") from the [International Criminal Court](/wiki/International_Criminal_Court "International Criminal Court") for [crimes against humanity](/wiki/Crimes_against_humanity "Crimes against humanity").[[86]](#cite_note-88)
  + [Balochistan Liberation Army](/wiki/Balochistan_Liberation_Army "Balochistan Liberation Army") militants [blow up railway tracks and hijack](/wiki/2025_Jaffar_Express_hijacking "2025 Jaffar Express hijacking") the [Jaffar Express](/wiki/Jaffar_Express "Jaffar Express") train bound from [Quetta](/wiki/Quetta "Quetta") to [Peshawar](/wiki/Peshawar "Peshawar"), taking 450 people hostages including both security personnel and civilians.[[87]](#cite_note-89)
  + [2025 Greenlandic general election](/wiki/2025_Greenlandic_general_election "2025 Greenlandic general election"): The center-right [Democrats](/wiki/Democrats_(Greenland) "Democrats (Greenland)") become the largest party, defeating the incumbent [Inuit Ataqatigiit](/wiki/Inuit_Ataqatigiit "Inuit Ataqatigiit").[[88]](#cite_note-90)
* [March 12](/wiki/March_12 "March 12") – [2025 Belizean general election](/wiki/2025_Belizean_general_election "2025 Belizean general election"): The incumbent [People's United Party](/wiki/People%27s_United_Party "People's United Party") wins a second term in a landslide victory.[[89]](#cite_note-91)
* [March 16](/wiki/March_16 "March 16")
  + A [fire breaks out](/wiki/Ko%C4%8Dani_nightclub_fire "Kočani nightclub fire") in a nightclub in [Kočani](/wiki/Ko%C4%8Dani "Kočani"), North Macedonia, killing at least 59 people and injuring 155 others.[[90]](#cite_note-92)
  + [Keith Rowley](/wiki/Keith_Rowley "Keith Rowley") resigns as [Prime Minister of Trinidad and Tobago](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Trinidad_and_Tobago "Prime Minister of Trinidad and Tobago") after nine years in office, and is succeeded by [Stuart Young](/wiki/Stuart_Young "Stuart Young").[[91]](#cite_note-93)[[92]](#cite_note-94)
* [March 18](/wiki/March_18 "March 18")
  + Israel [launches](/wiki/March_2025_Israeli_attacks_on_the_Gaza_Strip "March 2025 Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip") widespread aerial bombardments and attacks on the [Gaza Strip](/wiki/Gaza_Strip "Gaza Strip"), killing at least 591 people, including children, ending the [ceasefire agreement](/wiki/January_2025_Gaza_war_ceasefire "January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire") reached in January.[[93]](#cite_note-95)
  + The [President of Somalia](/wiki/President_of_Somalia "President of Somalia"), [Hassan Sheikh Mohamud](/wiki/Hassan_Sheikh_Mohamud "Hassan Sheikh Mohamud"), survives [an attack on his convoy](/wiki/Attempted_assassination_of_Hassan_Sheikh_Mohamud "Attempted assassination of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud") by [al-Shabaab](/wiki/Al-Shabaab_(militant_group) "Al-Shabaab (militant group)"), killing at least 10 people.[[94]](#cite_note-96)
* [March 19](/wiki/March_19 "March 19") – [Nationwide protests](/wiki/2025_Turkish_protests "2025 Turkish protests") erupt across [Turkey](/wiki/Turkey "Turkey") following the [arrest](/wiki/Arrest_of_Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu "Arrest of Ekrem İmamoğlu") of the mayor of [Istanbul](/wiki/Istanbul "Istanbul"), [Ekrem İmamoğlu](/wiki/Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu "Ekrem İmamoğlu"), on charges of corruption and terrorism.[[95]](#cite_note-97)[[96]](#cite_note-98)
* [March 20](/wiki/March_20 "March 20") – [Kirsty Coventry](/wiki/Kirsty_Coventry "Kirsty Coventry") is elected as the 10th, first female and first African [President of the International Olympic Committee](/wiki/President_of_the_International_Olympic_Committee "President of the International Olympic Committee") in the first round of voting in the [144th IOC Session](/wiki/144th_IOC_Session "144th IOC Session").[[97]](#cite_note-99)
* [March 21](/wiki/March_21 "March 21")
  + A major power outage causes [Heathrow Airport](/wiki/Heathrow_Airport "Heathrow Airport") in [London](/wiki/London "London") to completely shut down, with disruption expected to last for days, affecting thousands of flights around the world.[[98]](#cite_note-100)
  + South Korea experiences one of its [worst wildfires](/wiki/2025_South_Korea_wildfires "2025 South Korea wildfires") in modern history; over 87 000 hectares of land are destroyed in [South Gyeongsang Province](/wiki/South_Gyeongsang_Province "South Gyeongsang Province"), killing at least 32 people.[[99]](#cite_note-101)
* [March 28](/wiki/March_28 "March 28") – A 7.7-magnitude [earthquake](/wiki/2025_Myanmar_earthquake "2025 Myanmar earthquake") occurs in [Myanmar](/wiki/Myanmar "Myanmar"), resulting in 5,413 killed and 11,402 injured.[[100]](#cite_note-102)[[101]](#cite_note-103)[[102]](#cite_note-104)
* [March 31](/wiki/March_31 "March 31") – The [Caribbean guilder](/wiki/Caribbean_guilder "Caribbean guilder") is introduced, replacing the [Netherlands Antillean guilder](/wiki/Netherlands_Antillean_guilder "Netherlands Antillean guilder") as the currency for [Curaçao](/wiki/Cura%C3%A7ao "Curaçao") and [Sint Maarten](/wiki/Sint_Maarten "Sint Maarten").[[103]](#cite_note-105)

### April

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: April")]

* [April 1](/wiki/April_1 "April 1") – [Fram2](/wiki/Fram2 "Fram2") launches aboard a [SpaceX](/wiki/SpaceX "SpaceX") [Falcon 9](/wiki/Falcon_9 "Falcon 9") rocket, becoming the first [crewed spaceflight](/wiki/Human_spaceflight "Human spaceflight") to enter a [polar](/wiki/Polar_orbit "Polar orbit") [retrograde orbit](/wiki/Retrograde_orbit "Retrograde orbit").[[104]](#cite_note-106)[[105]](#cite_note-107)[[106]](#cite_note-108)
* [April 2](/wiki/April_2 "April 2") – US President [Donald Trump](/wiki/Donald_Trump "Donald Trump") issues [sweeping trade tariffs](/wiki/Tariffs_in_the_second_Trump_administration "Tariffs in the second Trump administration") on many countries, including a 10% baseline tariff for all imports.[[107]](#cite_note-109)[[108]](#cite_note-110)
* [April 3](/wiki/April_3 "April 3") – [Hungary](/wiki/Hungary "Hungary") withdraws from the [International Criminal Court](/wiki/International_Criminal_Court "International Criminal Court") after [Israeli Prime Minister](/wiki/Israeli_Prime_Minister "Israeli Prime Minister") and accused war criminal [Benjamin Netanyahu](/wiki/Benjamin_Netanyahu "Benjamin Netanyahu") lands in [Budapest](/wiki/Budapest "Budapest") for a state visit, in defiance of the [International Criminal Court's arrest warrant](/wiki/International_Criminal_Court_arrest_warrants_for_Israeli_leaders "International Criminal Court arrest warrants for Israeli leaders") against him.[[109]](#cite_note-israel-111)
* [April 4](/wiki/April_4 "April 4") – [Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol](/wiki/Impeachment_of_Yoon_Suk_Yeol "Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol"): The [Constitutional Court of Korea](/wiki/Constitutional_Court_of_Korea "Constitutional Court of Korea") unanimously upholds Yoon's impeachment in an 8–0 vote, officially removing him from office.[[110]](#cite_note-112)
* [April 7](/wiki/April_7 "April 7") – Colossal Biosciences showcases [three grey wolves](/wiki/Romulus,_Remus,_and_Khaleesi "Romulus, Remus, and Khaleesi") that are [genetically modified](/wiki/Genetically_modified "Genetically modified") to exhibit the characteristics of the [dire wolf](/wiki/Dire_wolf "Dire wolf").[[111]](#cite_note-RD-113)
* [April 8](/wiki/April_8 "April 8") – During a concert performance by [Rubby Pérez](/wiki/Rubby_P%C3%A9rez "Rubby Pérez") in [Santo Domingo](/wiki/Santo_Domingo "Santo Domingo"), a [nightclub roof collapses](/wiki/Jet_Set_nightclub_roof_collapse "Jet Set nightclub roof collapse"), killing at least 231 people, including Pérez, and injures more than 200 others.[[112]](#cite_note-114)[[113]](#cite_note-115)
* [April 12](/wiki/April_12 "April 12") – [2025 Gabonese presidential election](/wiki/2025_Gabonese_presidential_election "2025 Gabonese presidential election"): Incumbent transitional President [Brice Oligui Nguema](/wiki/Brice_Oligui_Nguema "Brice Oligui Nguema") wins a full term. The election is the first since the [2023 Gabonese coup d'état](/wiki/2023_Gabonese_coup_d%27%C3%A9tat "2023 Gabonese coup d'état"), and was preceded by a [constitutional referendum](/wiki/2024_Gabonese_constitutional_referendum "2024 Gabonese constitutional referendum") in 2024.[[114]](#cite_note-116)
* [April 13](/wiki/April_13 "April 13") – [October 13](/wiki/October_13 "October 13") – [Expo 2025](/wiki/Expo_2025 "Expo 2025") is held in [Osaka](/wiki/Osaka "Osaka"), Japan.[[115]](#cite_note-117)
* April 13 – [2025 Ecuadorian general election](/wiki/2025_Ecuadorian_general_election "2025 Ecuadorian general election"): Incumbent president [Daniel Noboa](/wiki/Daniel_Noboa "Daniel Noboa") is re-elected for a full term in the second round.[[116]](#cite_note-advance1-118)
* [April 15](/wiki/April_15 "April 15") – A motorized wooden boat capsizes after catching fire in the [Congo River](/wiki/Congo_River "Congo River") near the town of [Mbandaka](/wiki/Mbandaka "Mbandaka") in the [Democratic Republic of the Congo](/wiki/Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo "Democratic Republic of the Congo"), killing at least 148 people.[[117]](#cite_note-119)[[118]](#cite_note-120)[[119]](#cite_note-121)
* [April 17](/wiki/April_17 "April 17") – The [atmosphere](/wiki/Atmosphere "Atmosphere") of [K2-18b](/wiki/K2-18b "K2-18b"), a candidate [water world](/wiki/Ocean_world "Ocean world") located 124 [light-years](/wiki/Light-year "Light-year") away, is found to contain large quantities of [dimethyl sulfide](/wiki/Dimethyl_sulfide "Dimethyl sulfide") and/or [dimethyl disulfide](/wiki/Dimethyl_disulfide "Dimethyl disulfide") – two compounds that, on [Earth](/wiki/Earth "Earth"), are only known to be produced by life.[[120]](#cite_note-122)[[121]](#cite_note-123)[[122]](#cite_note-124)[[123]](#cite_note-125)
* [April 21](/wiki/April_21 "April 21") – [Pope Francis](/wiki/Pope_Francis "Pope Francis"), head of the Catholic Church since 2013, [dies](/wiki/Death_and_funeral_of_Pope_Francis "Death and funeral of Pope Francis") at the age of 88. World leaders pay tribute. Many countries declare [national mourning](/wiki/National_day_of_mourning "National day of mourning").[[124]](#cite_note-126)[[125]](#cite_note-127)
* [April 22](/wiki/April_22 "April 22") – Militants affiliated with [The Resistance Front](/wiki/The_Resistance_Front "The Resistance Front") [open fire](/wiki/2025_Pahalgam_attack "2025 Pahalgam attack") on a group of tourists at the [Baisaran Valley](/wiki/Baisaran_Valley "Baisaran Valley") in [Jammu and Kashmir](/wiki/Jammu_and_Kashmir_(union_territory) "Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)"), India, killing 26 and injuring at least 20.[[126]](#cite_note-jaz-128)
* [April 26](/wiki/April_26 "April 26")
  + The [funeral of Pope Francis](/wiki/Death_and_funeral_of_Pope_Francis "Death and funeral of Pope Francis") is attended by delegations from 164 countries, including 82 leaders, and 250,000 members of the public.[[127]](#cite_note-129)[[128]](#cite_note-130)[[129]](#cite_note-131)
  + An [explosion](/wiki/Port_of_Shahid_Rajaee_explosion "Port of Shahid Rajaee explosion") in the [Port of Shahid Rajaee](/wiki/Port_of_Shahid_Rajaee "Port of Shahid Rajaee"), [Bandar Abbas](/wiki/Bandar_Abbas "Bandar Abbas"), Iran, kills at least 70 people and injures more than 1,000.[[130]](#cite_note-132)[[131]](#cite_note-133)[[132]](#cite_note-134)
  + At least 11 people are killed and at least 32 others are injured in [a vehicle-ramming attack](/wiki/2025_Vancouver_car_attack "2025 Vancouver car attack") at the annual [Lapu Lapu Day](/wiki/Lapu_Lapu_Day "Lapu Lapu Day") festival in [Vancouver](/wiki/Vancouver "Vancouver"), British Columbia, Canada.[[133]](#cite_note-135)[[134]](#cite_note-136)
* [April 28](/wiki/April_28 "April 28")
  + [2025 Canadian federal election](/wiki/2025_Canadian_federal_election "2025 Canadian federal election"): Following [Justin Trudeau](/wiki/Justin_Trudeau "Justin Trudeau")'s resignation as prime minister in March, former [governor of the Bank of Canada](/wiki/Governor_of_the_Bank_of_Canada "Governor of the Bank of Canada") [Mark Carney](/wiki/Mark_Carney "Mark Carney") becomes the [Prime Minister of Canada](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Canada "Prime Minister of Canada"). The [Liberal Party](/wiki/Liberal_Party_of_Canada "Liberal Party of Canada") wins a fourth consecutive election and forms a minority government.[[135]](#cite_note-137)[[136]](#cite_note-138)[[137]](#cite_note-C16-139)[[138]](#cite_note-140)
  + A widespread [power outage](/wiki/2025_European_power_outage "2025 European power outage") affects [Spain](/wiki/Spain "Spain") and [Portugal](/wiki/Portugal "Portugal") for hours. [Andorra](/wiki/Andorra "Andorra") is affected for a few seconds while southern [France](/wiki/France "France") is lightly affected.[[139]](#cite_note-141)
  + [2025 Trinidad and Tobago general election](/wiki/2025_Trinidad_and_Tobago_general_election "2025 Trinidad and Tobago general election"): The [UNC](/wiki/United_National_Congress "United National Congress") wins a majority government, defeating the incumbent [PNM](/wiki/People%27s_National_Movement "People's National Movement").[[140]](#cite_note-142)
* [April 30](/wiki/April_30 "April 30") – The [Ukraine–United States Mineral Resources Agreement](/wiki/Ukraine%E2%80%93United_States_Mineral_Resources_Agreement "Ukraine–United States Mineral Resources Agreement") is signed, providing an economic incentive for the US to continue to invest in Ukraine's defence and reconstruction, in exchange for access to the war-torn country's energy and mineral resources.[[141]](#cite_note-143)

### May

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: May")]

* [May 3](/wiki/May_3 "May 3")
  + [2025 Australian federal election](/wiki/2025_Australian_federal_election "2025 Australian federal election"): The incumbent [Labor Party](/wiki/Australian_Labor_Party "Australian Labor Party") led by [Anthony Albanese](/wiki/Anthony_Albanese "Anthony Albanese") wins reelection, increasing their majority.[[142]](#cite_note-144)[[143]](#cite_note-145)
  + [2025 Singaporean general election](/wiki/2025_Singaporean_general_election "2025 Singaporean general election"): The incumbent [People's Action Party](/wiki/People%27s_Action_Party "People's Action Party") led by [Lawrence Wong](/wiki/Lawrence_Wong "Lawrence Wong") wins reelection in a landslide, retaining a supermajority government.[[144]](#cite_note-146)
  + [2025 Malian protests](/wiki/2025_Malian_protests "2025 Malian protests"): Hundreds of demonstrators gather in [Bamako](/wiki/Bamako "Bamako"), [Mali](/wiki/Mali "Mali"), to protest the [government](/wiki/Politics_of_Mali "Politics of Mali")'s proposed dissolution of political parties and extension of president [Assimi Goïta](/wiki/Assimi_Go%C3%AFta "Assimi Goïta")'s mandate by 5 years.[[145]](#cite_note-147) The protests mark the first pro-democracy demonstrations in the country since the regime took power in [2021](/wiki/2021_Malian_coup_d%27%C3%A9tat "2021 Malian coup d'état").[[146]](#cite_note-148)
* [May 6](/wiki/May_6 "May 6") – [2025 German federal election](/wiki/2025_German_federal_election "2025 German federal election"): [Friedrich Merz](/wiki/Friedrich_Merz "Friedrich Merz") is elected [Chancellor of Germany](/wiki/Chancellor_of_Germany "Chancellor of Germany") in the second round of parliamentary voting, hours after being defeated in the first round, a first in post-[WWII](/wiki/World_War_II "World War II") German history.[[147]](#cite_note-149)[[148]](#cite_note-150)[[149]](#cite_note-151)
* [May 7](/wiki/May_7 "May 7") – [2025 India–Pakistan conflict](/wiki/2025_India%E2%80%93Pakistan_conflict "2025 India–Pakistan conflict"): India launches several missiles into Pakistani territory in response to the [2025 Pahalgam attack](/wiki/2025_Pahalgam_attack "2025 Pahalgam attack") two weeks prior.[[150]](#cite_note-152)
* [May 7](/wiki/May_7 "May 7")–[8](/wiki/May_8 "May 8") – [2025 conclave](/wiki/2025_conclave "2025 conclave"): 133 cardinal electors select Robert Francis Prevost as [Pope Francis](/wiki/Pope_Francis "Pope Francis")'s successor, on the fourth ballot. He takes the name [Leo XIV](/wiki/Pope_Leo_XIV "Pope Leo XIV"), and becomes the first pope from North America, the first with Peruvian or U.S. citizenship, and the first from the [Order of Saint Augustine](/wiki/Order_of_Saint_Augustine "Order of Saint Augustine").[[151]](#cite_note-153)
* [May 9](/wiki/May_9 "May 9")–[25](/wiki/May_25 "May 25") – The [2025 IIHF World Championship](/wiki/2025_IIHF_World_Championship "2025 IIHF World Championship") is held in [Stockholm](/wiki/Stockholm "Stockholm"), Sweden, and [Herning](/wiki/Herning "Herning"), Denmark, and [is won](/wiki/2025_IIHF_World_Championship_final "2025 IIHF World Championship final") by the [United States](/wiki/United_States_men%27s_national_ice_hockey_team "United States men's national ice hockey team").[[152]](#cite_note-154)
* [May 11](/wiki/May_11 "May 11") – [2025 Albanian parliamentary election](/wiki/2025_Albanian_parliamentary_election "2025 Albanian parliamentary election"): The incumbent [Socialist Party](/wiki/Socialist_Party_of_Albania "Socialist Party of Albania") led by [Edi Rama](/wiki/Edi_Rama "Edi Rama") wins reelection, retaining a majority government.[[153]](#cite_note-155)
* [May 12](/wiki/May_12 "May 12")
  + [2025 Philippine general election](/wiki/2025_Philippine_general_election "2025 Philippine general election"): The ruling [Alyansa para sa Bagong Pilipinas](/wiki/Alyansa_para_sa_Bagong_Pilipinas "Alyansa para sa Bagong Pilipinas") alliance win a narrow majority of the seats in the [Senate](/wiki/2025_Philippine_Senate_election "2025 Philippine Senate election"), while one of its component parties [Lakas–CMD](/wiki/Lakas%E2%80%93CMD "Lakas–CMD") wins the plurality of seats in the [House of Representatives](/wiki/2025_Philippine_House_of_Representatives_elections "2025 Philippine House of Representatives elections").[[154]](#cite_note-156)[[155]](#cite_note-157)
  + The [Kurdistan Workers' Party](/wiki/Kurdistan_Workers%27_Party "Kurdistan Workers' Party") announces its dissolution after previously [declaring a ceasefire](/wiki/2025_PKK%E2%80%93Turkey_peace_process "2025 PKK–Turkey peace process") with Turkey.[[156]](#cite_note-158)
* [May 13](/wiki/May_13 "May 13")–[17](/wiki/May_17 "May 17") – The [Eurovision Song Contest 2025](/wiki/Eurovision_Song_Contest_2025 "Eurovision Song Contest 2025") is held in [Basel](/wiki/Basel "Basel"), Switzerland. [Austrian](/wiki/Austria "Austria") contestant [JJ](/wiki/JJ_(singer) "JJ (singer)") wins with the song "[Wasted Love](/wiki/Wasted_Love_(JJ_song) "Wasted Love (JJ song)")".[[157]](#cite_note-159)
* [May 18](/wiki/May_18 "May 18")

### June

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: June")]

  + [2025 Polish presidential election](/wiki/2025_Polish_presidential_election "2025 Polish presidential election"): [Karol Nawrocki](/wiki/Karol_Nawrocki "Karol Nawrocki") is narrowly elected [President of Poland](/wiki/President_of_Poland "President of Poland") in the second round of voting, beating [Rafał Trzaskowski](/wiki/Rafa%C5%82_Trzaskowski "Rafał Trzaskowski").[[165]](#cite_note-167)[[166]](#cite_note-168)

  + [2025 South Korean presidential election](/wiki/2025_South_Korean_presidential_election "2025 South Korean presidential election"): After being pushed forward as a result of the [impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol](/wiki/Impeachment_of_Yoon_Suk_Yeol "Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol"), [Lee Jae Myung](/wiki/Lee_Jae_Myung "Lee Jae Myung") wins the election, beating [Kim Moon-soo](/wiki/Kim_Moon-soo_(politician) "Kim Moon-soo (politician)").[[168]](#cite_note-170)

* [June 6](/wiki/June_6 "June 6") – [June 2025 Los Angeles protests](/wiki/June_2025_Los_Angeles_protests "June 2025 Los Angeles protests"): Protests erupt in [Los Angeles](/wiki/Los_Angeles "Los Angeles") in response to [Immigration and Customs Enforcement](/wiki/U.S._Immigration_and_Customs_Enforcement "U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement") (ICE) arrests and deportations of [illegal immigrants](/wiki/Illegal_immigration_to_the_United_States "Illegal immigration to the United States").[[170]](#cite_note-172)[[171]](#cite_note-173)[[172]](#cite_note-174)[[173]](#cite_note-175)
* [June 10](/wiki/June_10 "June 10") – 10 people are killed and more than 30 others injured after a gunman [opens fire](/wiki/2025_Graz_school_shooting "2025 Graz school shooting") at a school in [Graz](/wiki/Graz "Graz"), [Austria](/wiki/Austria "Austria").[[174]](#cite_note-176)
* [June 12](/wiki/June_12 "June 12") – [Air India Flight 171](/wiki/Air_India_Flight_171 "Air India Flight 171"), a London-bound [Boeing 787](/wiki/Boeing_787 "Boeing 787"), crashes into a building after take-off from [Ahmedabad](/wiki/Ahmedabad "Ahmedabad"), India, killing 229 passengers, 12 crew on board, and 19 people on the ground. * [June 13](/wiki/June_13 "June 13") – [Iran–Israel war](/wiki/Iran%E2%80%93Israel_war "Iran–Israel war"): Israel conducts air strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities, killing military commanders including [Hossein Salami](/wiki/Hossein_Salami "Hossein Salami"); Iran retaliates.[[178]](#cite_note-180)[[179]](#cite_note-181)
* [June 14](/wiki/June_14 "June 14") – [July 13](/wiki/July_13 "July 13") – The [2025 FIFA Club World Cup](/wiki/2025_FIFA_Club_World_Cup "2025 FIFA Club World Cup") is held in the [United States](/wiki/United_States "United States"), and [is won](/wiki/2025_FIFA_Club_World_Cup_final "2025 FIFA Club World Cup final") by [Chelsea](/wiki/Chelsea_F.C. "Chelsea F.C.").[[180]](#cite_note-182)

* [June 16](/wiki/June_16 "June 16")–[17](/wiki/June_17 "June 17") – The [51st G7 summit](/wiki/51st_G7_summit "51st G7 summit") is held in [Kananaskis, Canada](/wiki/Kananaskis_Improvement_District "Kananaskis Improvement District").[[183]](#cite_note-185)

* [June 21](/wiki/June_21 "June 21") – Belarusian opposition leader [Sergei Tikhanovsky](/wiki/Sergei_Tikhanovsky "Sergei Tikhanovsky") and 13 other political prisoners are released from prison and deported to Lithuania following a pardon as a result of negotiations with Trump's envoy in Minsk.[[185]](#cite_note-187)
* [June 22](/wiki/June_22 "June 22") – [Iran–Israel war](/wiki/Iran%E2%80%93Israel_war "Iran–Israel war"): The [United States](/wiki/United_States "United States") carries out [B-2 bomber](/wiki/Northrop_B-2_Spirit "Northrop B-2 Spirit") [airstrikes on three Iranian nuclear sites](/wiki/American_strikes_on_Iranian_nuclear_sites "American strikes on Iranian nuclear sites") in [Fordow](/wiki/Fordow_Uranium_Enrichment_Plant "Fordow Uranium Enrichment Plant"), [Natanz](/wiki/Natanz_Nuclear_Facility "Natanz Nuclear Facility"), and [Isfahan](/wiki/Isfahan_Nuclear_Technology/Research_Center "Isfahan Nuclear Technology/Research Center").[[186]](#cite_note-188)
* [June 23](/wiki/June_23 "June 23") – Iran [launches missiles at US bases](/wiki/2025_Iranian_strikes_on_Al_Udeid_Air_Base "2025 Iranian strikes on Al Udeid Air Base") in [Qatar](/wiki/Qatar "Qatar") and [Iraq](/wiki/Iraq "Iraq") in response to the previous day's strikes.[[187]](#cite_note-189)
* [June 24](/wiki/June_24 "June 24")–[25](/wiki/June_25 "June 25") – A [NATO summit](/wiki/2025_The_Hague_NATO_summit "2025 The Hague NATO summit") is held at the [World Forum](/wiki/World_Forum_(The_Hague) "World Forum (The Hague)") in [The Hague, Netherlands](/wiki/The_Hague "The Hague").[[188]](#cite_note-190)
* [June 25](/wiki/June_25 "June 25") – The [Axiom Mission 4](/wiki/Axiom_Mission_4 "Axiom Mission 4") is launched. The mission involves four astronauts, including the first astronauts from Poland ([Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski](/wiki/S%C5%82awosz_Uzna%C5%84ski-Wi%C5%9Bniewski "Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski")) and India ([Shubhanshu Shukla](/wiki/Shubhanshu_Shukla "Shubhanshu Shukla")) since the end of the [Cold War](/wiki/Cold_War "Cold War").[[189]](#cite_note-191)[[190]](#cite_note-192)
* [June 27](/wiki/June_27 "June 27") – The U.S., with Qatari support, brokers a preliminary [peace treaty](/wiki/2025_Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo%E2%80%93Rwanda_peace_agreement "2025 Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda peace agreement") between the [Democratic Republic of the Congo](/wiki/Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo "Democratic Republic of the Congo") and [Rwanda](/wiki/Rwanda "Rwanda"), ending [their armed conflict](/wiki/Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo%E2%80%93Rwanda_conflict_(2022%E2%80%93present) "Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict (2022–present)") that started in 2022.[[191]](#cite_note-193)

* [July 4](/wiki/July_4 "July 4")–[7](/wiki/July_7 "July 7") – At least 135 people are killed and over a hundred reported missing during a [flood in Central Texas](/wiki/July_2025_Central_Texas_floods "July 2025 Central Texas floods"), United States.[[193]](#cite_note-195)

* [July 24](/wiki/July_24 "July 24")
  + [Angara Airlines Flight 2311](/wiki/Angara_Airlines_Flight_2311 "Angara Airlines Flight 2311"), operated by an [Antonov An-24](/wiki/Antonov_An-24 "Antonov An-24") aircraft, crashes near [Tynda](/wiki/Tynda "Tynda") in Eastern Siberia, Russia. All 48 people on board are killed.[[200]](#cite_note-202)
  + Armed [conflicts](/wiki/2025_Cambodia%E2%80%93Thailand_border_conflict "2025 Cambodia–Thailand border conflict") break out between [Cambodia](/wiki/Cambodia "Cambodia") and [Thailand](/wiki/Thailand "Thailand") after the escalation of a border dispute. * [July 30](/wiki/July_30 "July 30") – An [Mw](/wiki/Seismic_magnitude_scales#Mw "Seismic magnitude scales") [8.8 earthquake](/wiki/2025_Kamchatka_Peninsula_earthquake "2025 Kamchatka Peninsula earthquake") strikes off the coast of Russia's [Kamchatka Peninsula](/wiki/Kamchatka_Peninsula "Kamchatka Peninsula"), triggering tsunami warnings in [Japan](/wiki/Japan "Japan") and [Hawaii](/wiki/Hawaii "Hawaii").[[202]](#cite_note-204)

### August

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: August")]

* [August 7](/wiki/August_7 "August 7") – [OpenAI](/wiki/OpenAI "OpenAI")'s model [GPT-5](/wiki/GPT-5 "GPT-5") is released.[[204]](#cite_note-206)

* [August 15](/wiki/August_15 "August 15")–[17](/wiki/August_17 "August 17") – The first [World Humanoid Robot Games](/wiki/World_Humanoid_Robot_Games "World Humanoid Robot Games") are held in [Beijing](/wiki/Beijing "Beijing"), [China](/wiki/China "China").[[207]](#cite_note-209)[[208]](#cite_note-210)

* [August 22](/wiki/August_22 "August 22") – [September 27](/wiki/September_27 "September 27") – The [2025 Women's Rugby World Cup](/wiki/2025_Women%27s_Rugby_World_Cup "2025 Women's Rugby World Cup") is held in, and [is won](/wiki/2025_Women%27s_Rugby_World_Cup_final "2025 Women's Rugby World Cup final") by, [England](/wiki/England_women%27s_national_rugby_union_team "England women's national rugby union team").[[211]](#cite_note-213)
* [August 30](/wiki/August_30 "August 30") – [2025 Thai political crisis](/wiki/2025_Thai_political_crisis "2025 Thai political crisis"): The [Constitutional Court of Thailand](/wiki/Constitutional_Court_of_Thailand "Constitutional Court of Thailand") removes [Prime Minister](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Thailand "Prime Minister of Thailand") [Paetongtarn Shinawatra](/wiki/Paetongtarn_Shinawatra "Paetongtarn Shinawatra") from office for ethical misconduct over [leaked phone calls](/wiki/Thailand%E2%80%93Cambodia_phone_call_leak "Thailand–Cambodia phone call leak") she had with former [Cambodian Prime Minister](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Cambodia "Prime Minister of Cambodia") [Hun Sen](/wiki/Hun_Sen "Hun Sen").[[212]](#cite_note-214)[[213]](#cite_note-215)

  + An [earthquake](/wiki/2025_Kunar_earthquake "2025 Kunar earthquake") in eastern [Afghanistan](/wiki/Afghanistan "Afghanistan") kills over 2,200 people and injures 3,500.[[214]](#cite_note-216)
  + Between 370 and 1,000 people are reported killed in a [landslide](/wiki/2025_Tarasin_landslide "2025 Tarasin landslide") caused by heavy rain that buries the village of Tarasin in the [Marrah Mountains](/wiki/Marrah_Mountains "Marrah Mountains") of [Central Darfur](/wiki/Central_Darfur "Central Darfur") and leaves one survivor.[[215]](#cite_note-217)[[216]](#cite_note-218)

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section: September")]

* [September 30](/wiki/September_30 "September 30") – A [Mw](/wiki/Seismic_magnitude_scales#Mw "Seismic magnitude scales") [6.9 earthquake](/wiki/2025_Cebu_earthquake "2025 Cebu earthquake") shakes the island of [Cebu](/wiki/Cebu "Cebu") in the Philippines, leaving 71 people dead and 559 injured.[[246]](#cite_note-ndrrmc5-248)

### October

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section: October")]

  + [Henri, Grand Duke of Luxembourg](/wiki/Henri,_Grand_Duke_of_Luxembourg "Henri, Grand Duke of Luxembourg"), [abdicates the throne](/wiki/Abdication_of_Henri,_Grand_Duke_of_Luxembourg "Abdication of Henri, Grand Duke of Luxembourg") in favor of his son [Guillaume](/wiki/Guillaume_V,_Grand_Duke_of_Luxembourg "Guillaume V, Grand Duke of Luxembourg").[[249]](#cite_note-251)
  + [Dame Sarah Mullally](/wiki/Sarah_Mullally "Sarah Mullally") is named the first female [Archbishop of Canterbury](/wiki/Archbishop_of_Canterbury "Archbishop of Canterbury").[[250]](#cite_note-252)

  + Israel and Hamas agree to the first phase of a [Gaza](/wiki/Gaza_war "Gaza war") [peace deal](/wiki/Gaza_peace_plan "Gaza peace plan"), paving the way for a ceasefire, almost exactly two years after the [conflict](/wiki/Gaza_War "Gaza War") began.[[253]](#cite_note-255)
  + [2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict](/wiki/2025_Afghanistan%E2%80%93Pakistan_conflict "2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict"): Pakistan reportedly carries out airstrikes in [Kabul](/wiki/Kabul "Kabul"), [Khost](/wiki/Khost "Khost"), [Jalalabad](/wiki/Jalalabad "Jalalabad"), and [Paktika](/wiki/Paktika "Paktika"), targeting [Noor Wali Mehsud](/wiki/Noor_Wali_Mehsud "Noor Wali Mehsud"), an internationally designated terrorist.[[254]](#cite_note-256)

* [October 10](/wiki/October_10 "October 10") – [Dina Boluarte](/wiki/Dina_Boluarte "Dina Boluarte"), the [President of Peru](/wiki/President_of_Peru "President of Peru"), is unanimously [impeached](/wiki/Impeachment_of_Dina_Boluarte "Impeachment of Dina Boluarte") by the [Congress of the Republic](/wiki/Congress_of_the_Republic_of_Peru "Congress of the Republic of Peru").[[256]](#cite_note-258)

  + [2025 Malagasy coup d'état](/wiki/2025_Malagasy_coup_d%27%C3%A9tat "2025 Malagasy coup d'état"): Following a series of [protests](/wiki/2025_Malagasy_protests "2025 Malagasy protests"), incumbent [President](/wiki/President_of_Madagascar "President of Madagascar") [Andry Rajoelina](/wiki/Andry_Rajoelina "Andry Rajoelina") is ousted and military officer [Michael Randrianirina](/wiki/Michael_Randrianirina "Michael Randrianirina") becomes President.[[258]](#cite_note-260)

Incumbent party [MAS-IPSP](/wiki/Movimiento_al_Socialismo "Movimiento al Socialismo") loses all their seats in the [Senate](/wiki/Chamber_of_Senators_(Bolivia) "Chamber of Senators (Bolivia)") and all but two seats in the [Chamber of Deputies](/wiki/Chamber_of_Deputies_(Bolivia) "Chamber of Deputies (Bolivia)").[[261]](#cite_note-263)
  + [2025 Louvre heist](/wiki/2025_Louvre_heist "2025 Louvre heist"): Pieces of the [French Crown Jewels](/wiki/French_Crown_Jewels "French Crown Jewels") are stolen during a robbery from the [Galerie d'Apollon](/wiki/Galerie_d%27Apollon "Galerie d'Apollon") of the [Louvre](/wiki/Louvre "Louvre") in [Paris](/wiki/Paris "Paris").[[262]](#cite_note-264)[[263]](#cite_note-265)
* [October 21](/wiki/October_21 "October 21")
  + [Sanae Takaichi](/wiki/Sanae_Takaichi "Sanae Takaichi") becomes the first female [Prime Minister of Japan](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Japan "Prime Minister of Japan").[[264]](#cite_note-266)
  + American [Eric Lu](/wiki/Eric_Lu "Eric Lu") wins the quinquennial [XIX International Chopin Piano Competition](/wiki/XIX_International_Chopin_Piano_Competition "XIX International Chopin Piano Competition") at the [National Philharmonic](/wiki/National_Philharmonic,_Warsaw "National Philharmonic, Warsaw") in [Warsaw](/wiki/Warsaw "Warsaw"), [Poland](/wiki/Poland "Poland").[[265]](#cite_note-267)
* [October 22](/wiki/October_22 "October 22")-[23](/wiki/October_23 "October 23") – [King Charles III](/wiki/Charles_III "Charles III") and [Queen Camilla](/wiki/Queen_Camilla "Queen Camilla") made their [historic visit](/wiki/State_visit_by_Charles_III_to_the_Holy_See "State visit by Charles III to the Holy See") to the [Vatican](/wiki/Vatican_City "Vatican City") with [Pope Leo XIV](/wiki/Pope_Leo_XIV "Pope Leo XIV") (who was [elected](/wiki/2025_conclave "2025 conclave") in May) as the first [Chicago](/wiki/Chicago "Chicago")-born pope from [Illinois](/wiki/Illinois "Illinois"), marking a significant milestone in [Anglo-Catholic relations](/wiki/Holy_See%E2%80%93United_Kingdom_relations "Holy See–United Kingdom relations"), Charles III became the first British monarch to pray in a church service with a pope in 500 years since [The Reformation](/wiki/English_Reformation "English Reformation") by [King Henry VIII](/wiki/Henry_VIII "Henry VIII").
* [October 24](/wiki/October_24 "October 24") – [2025 Irish presidential election](/wiki/2025_Irish_presidential_election "2025 Irish presidential election"): Independent candidate [Catherine Connolly](/wiki/Catherine_Connolly "Catherine Connolly") wins the election in a landslide, defeating [Fine Gael](/wiki/Fine_Gael "Fine Gael") candidate [Heather Humphreys](/wiki/Heather_Humphreys "Heather Humphreys").[[266]](#cite_note-268)

  + [El Fashir massacre](/wiki/El_Fashir_massacre "El Fashir massacre"): Mass murder is reported during which an estimated 2,500 or more civilians have been executed by the [Rapid Support Forces](/wiki/Rapid_Support_Forces "Rapid Support Forces") in the city of [El Fashir](/wiki/El_Fashir "El Fashir"), Sudan.[[269]](#cite_note-271)
* [October 28](/wiki/October_28 "October 28")
  + [Hurricane Melissa](/wiki/Hurricane_Melissa "Hurricane Melissa") makes landfall in [Jamaica](/wiki/Jamaica "Jamaica") as a [Category 5 hurricane](/wiki/Category_5_hurricane "Category 5 hurricane"), with sustained wind speeds up to 185 mph (295 km/h).[[270]](#cite_note-272)[[271]](#cite_note-273)
  + [Operation Containment](/wiki/Operation_Containment "Operation Containment"): In [Rio de Janeiro](/wiki/Rio_de_Janeiro "Rio de Janeiro"), more than 120 people are killed in raids targeting [criminal organization](/wiki/Organized_crime "Organized crime") [Comando Vermelho](/wiki/Comando_Vermelho "Comando Vermelho") during the deadliest police operation in Brazilian history.[[272]](#cite_note-274)[[273]](#cite_note-275)
* [October 29](/wiki/October_29 "October 29") – [2025 Dutch general election](/wiki/2025_Dutch_general_election "2025 Dutch general election"): [Social liberal](/wiki/Social_liberalism "Social liberalism") party [Democrats 66](/wiki/Democrats_66 "Democrats 66") ties with [right-wing populist](/wiki/Right-wing_populism "Right-wing populism") party [Party for Freedom](/wiki/Party_for_Freedom "Party for Freedom") in most number of seats.[[274]](#cite_note-276)

### November

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section: November")]

* [November 3](/wiki/November_3 "November 3") – A powerful [Mw](/wiki/Seismic_magnitude_scales#Mw "Seismic magnitude scales") [6.3 earthquake](/wiki/2025_Balkh_earthquake "2025 Balkh earthquake") shakes the provinces of [Balkh](/wiki/Balkh_Province "Balkh Province") and [Samangan](/wiki/Samangan_Province "Samangan Province") in [Afghanistan](/wiki/Afghanistan "Afghanistan"), causing 31 deaths and 956 injuries.[[275]](#cite_note-277)

  + [Typhoon Kalmaegi](/wiki/Typhoon_Kalmaegi "Typhoon Kalmaegi") leaves more than 288 people dead in the [Philippines](/wiki/Philippines "Philippines"), [Vietnam](/wiki/Vietnam "Vietnam"), and [Thailand](/wiki/Thailand "Thailand").[[276]](#cite_note-278)[[277]](#cite_note-279)[[278]](#cite_note-280)

* [November 11](/wiki/November_11 "November 11") – [2025 Iraqi parliamentary election](/wiki/2025_Iraqi_parliamentary_election "2025 Iraqi parliamentary election"): Incumbent Prime Minister [Mohammed Shia' al-Sudani](/wiki/Mohammed_Shia%27_al-Sudani "Mohammed Shia' al-Sudani")'s party [RDC](/wiki/Reconstruction_and_Development_Coalition "Reconstruction and Development Coalition") wins a plurality of seats.[[282]](#cite_note-284)

* [November 22](/wiki/November_22 "November 22")–[23](/wiki/November_23 "November 23") – The [G20 Johannesburg summit](/wiki/2025_G20_Johannesburg_summit "2025 G20 Johannesburg summit") is held in [South Africa](/wiki/South_Africa "South Africa"), the first time a [G20](/wiki/G20 "G20") summit has been held in Africa.[[286]](#cite_note-288)

* [November 24](/wiki/November_24 "November 24")–[25](/wiki/November_25 "November 25") – The second round of the [2025 Egyptian parliamentary election](/wiki/2025_Egyptian_parliamentary_election "2025 Egyptian parliamentary election") is held.[[289]](#cite_note-291)

* [November 26](/wiki/November_26 "November 26")
  + A [massive fire](/wiki/Wang_Fuk_Court_fire "Wang Fuk Court fire") engulfs the Wang Fuk Court apartment block in [Hong Kong](/wiki/Hong_Kong "Hong Kong"), killing at least 168[[292]](#cite_note-wikidata-ab5b86ea60d32cf746f739689c1580778a49c56e-v20-294)[[293]](#cite_note-wikidata-c82fab34318122c9c835a982cc5487135971bd56-v20-295) people and leaving over 150 missing.[[294]](#cite_note-296)

* [November 28](/wiki/November_28 "November 28") – Flooding and landslides caused by [Cyclone Ditwah](/wiki/Cyclone_Ditwah "Cyclone Ditwah") leave at least 647 dead and 183 missing across [Sri Lanka](/wiki/Sri_Lanka "Sri Lanka") and [South India](/wiki/South_India "South India").[[298]](#cite_note-300)

  + The [2025 Kyrgyz parliamentary election](/wiki/2025_Kyrgyz_parliamentary_election "2025 Kyrgyz parliamentary election") is held.[[299]](#cite_note-301)
  + [2025 Honduran general election](/wiki/2025_Honduran_general_election "2025 Honduran general election"): Amid allegations of fraud and external interference, [National](/wiki/National_Party_of_Honduras "National Party of Honduras") candidate [Nasry Asfura](/wiki/Nasry_Asfura "Nasry Asfura") narrowly wins the presidency after weeks of delays. The National Party additionally wins a plurality in the [National Congress](/wiki/National_Congress_of_Honduras "National Congress of Honduras").[[300]](#cite_note-302)

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=2025&action=edit&section=13 "Edit section: December")]

  + A [fire](/wiki/2025_Arpora_nightclub_fire "2025 Arpora nightclub fire") at a nightclub in [Arpora](/wiki/Arpora "Arpora"), [Goa](/wiki/Goa "Goa"), India, leaves at least 25 people dead and 50 injured.[[304]](#cite_note-306)
* [December 8](/wiki/December_8 "December 8") – A [Mw](/wiki/Seismic_magnitude_scales#Mw "Seismic magnitude scales") [7.6 earthquake](/wiki/2025_Sanriku_earthquake "2025 Sanriku earthquake") occurs in the [Pacific Ocean](/wiki/Pacific_Ocean "Pacific Ocean") off the coast of [Aomori Prefecture](/wiki/Aomori_Prefecture "Aomori Prefecture") in [Japan](/wiki/Japan "Japan"), triggering a [tsunami](/wiki/Tsunami "Tsunami") up to 70 cm high.[[305]](#cite_note-307)[[306]](#cite_note-308)
* [December 11](/wiki/December_11 "December 11") – [2021–present Bulgarian political crisis](/wiki/2021%E2%80%93present_Bulgarian_political_crisis "2021–present Bulgarian political crisis"): The [Zhelyazkov Government](/wiki/Zhelyazkov_Government "Zhelyazkov Government") resigns following [major protests](/wiki/2025_Bulgarian_budget_protests "2025 Bulgarian budget protests").[[307]](#cite_note-309)[[308]](#cite_note-310)
* [December 13](/wiki/December_13 "December 13")
  + Belarus releases 123 political prisoners including opposition leaders [Maria Kalesnikava](/wiki/Maria_Kalesnikava "Maria Kalesnikava"), [Maxim Znak](/wiki/Maxim_Znak "Maxim Znak"), [Viktar Babaryka](/wiki/Viktar_Babaryka "Viktar Babaryka"), Nobel laureate [Ales Bialiatski](/wiki/Ales_Bialiatski "Ales Bialiatski"), and journalists [Pavel Sevyarynets](/wiki/Pavel_Sevyarynets "Pavel Sevyarynets") and [Marina Zolotova](/wiki/Marina_Zolotova "Marina Zolotova") in exchange for the lifting of sanctions on the Belarusian potash industry by the United States.[[309]](#cite_note-311)
  + The [Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2025](/wiki/Junior_Eurovision_Song_Contest_2025 "Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2025") is held in [Tbilisi](/wiki/Tbilisi "Tbilisi"), [Georgia](/wiki/Georgia_(country) "Georgia (country)"). [French](/wiki/France "France") contestant [Lou Deleuze](/wiki/Lou_Deleuze "Lou Deleuze") wins with the song "[Ce monde](/wiki/Ce_monde "Ce monde")".[[310]](#cite_note-312)
* [December 14](/wiki/December_14 "December 14")
  + [2025 Chilean general election](/wiki/2025_Chilean_general_election "2025 Chilean general election"): [José Antonio Kast](/wiki/Jos%C3%A9_Antonio_Kast "José Antonio Kast") is elected [President of Chile](/wiki/President_of_Chile "President of Chile"). Right-wing coalitions gain control of the [Chamber of Deputies](/wiki/Chamber_of_Deputies_of_Chile "Chamber of Deputies of Chile") and tie in the [Senate](/wiki/Senate_of_Chile "Senate of Chile").[[311]](#cite_note-313)
  + At least 16 people are killed and 43 injured in a [mass shooting](/wiki/2025_Bondi_Beach_shooting "2025 Bondi Beach shooting"), classified as a [terrorist attack](/wiki/Terrorism_in_Australia "Terrorism in Australia"),[[312]](#cite_note-314) by two gunmen at [Bondi Beach](/wiki/Bondi_Beach "Bondi Beach") in [Sydney](/wiki/Sydney "Sydney") during a celebration for the start of the Jewish festival of [Hanukkah](/wiki/Hanukkah "Hanukkah").[[313]](#cite_note-315)
* [December 19](/wiki/December_19 "December 19") – [EU](/wiki/European_Union "European Union") leaders approve a €90bn ($105bn) loan for [Ukraine](/wiki/Ukraine "Ukraine") for the next two years, which Kyiv will repay only once Russia pays reparations.[[314]](#cite_note-316)
* [December 20](/wiki/December_20 "December 20") – German engineer [Michaela Benthaus](/wiki/Michaela_Benthaus "Michaela Benthaus") becomes the first [wheelchair](/wiki/Wheelchair "Wheelchair") user to travel into [space](/wiki/Outer_space "Outer space"), aboard the [Blue Origin NS-37](/wiki/Blue_Origin_NS-37 "Blue Origin NS-37").[[315]](#cite_note-317)
* [December 21](/wiki/December_21 "December 21") – [January 18](/wiki/January_18 "January 18") – The [2025 Africa Cup of Nations](/wiki/2025_Africa_Cup_of_Nations "2025 Africa Cup of Nations") is held in [Morocco](/wiki/Morocco "Morocco"), and [is won](/wiki/2025_Africa_Cup_of_Nations_final "2025 Africa Cup of Nations final") by [Senegal](/wiki/Senegal_national_football_team "Senegal national football team").[[316]](#cite_note-318)
* [December 23](/wiki/December_23 "December 23") – [Harmony Jets Flight 185](/wiki/Harmony_Jets_Flight_185 "Harmony Jets Flight 185"), a [Dassault Falcon 50](/wiki/Dassault_Falcon_50 "Dassault Falcon 50"), crashes near [Ankara](/wiki/Ankara "Ankara"), [Turkey](/wiki/Turkey "Turkey"), killing all eight people on board, including [Libyan Army](/wiki/Libyan_Army "Libyan Army") chief of staff [Mohammed al-Haddad](/wiki/Mohammed_al-Haddad "Mohammed al-Haddad").[[317]](#cite_note-319)
* [December 25](/wiki/December_25 "December 25") – The [United States](/wiki/United_States "United States"), in cooperation with the [Nigerian](/wiki/Nigeria "Nigeria") government, initiates a [series of airstrikes](/wiki/2025_United_States_strikes_in_Nigeria "2025 United States strikes in Nigeria") targeting [Islamic State](/wiki/Islamic_State "Islamic State")-affiliated militants operating in the country's [Sokoto State](/wiki/Sokoto_State "Sokoto State").[[318]](#cite_note-320)[[319]](#cite_note-321) US President Donald Trump states that rising [extremist violence against Christians](/wiki/Religious_violence_in_Nigeria "Religious violence in Nigeria") is a primary reason for the strikes.[[320]](#cite_note-322)
* [December 26](/wiki/December_26 "December 26") – [Israel](/wiki/Israel "Israel") becomes the first country to recognize [Somaliland](/wiki/Somaliland "Somaliland").[[321]](#cite_note-323)
* [December 28](/wiki/December_28 "December 28")
  + [2025 Central African general election](/wiki/2025_Central_African_general_election "2025 Central African general election"): Incumbent president [Faustin-Archange Touadéra](/wiki/Faustin-Archange_Touad%C3%A9ra "Faustin-Archange Touadéra") wins reelection for a third term.[[322]](#cite_note-324)
  + [2025 Guinean presidential election](/wiki/2025_Guinean_presidential_election "2025 Guinean presidential election"): Interim president and [2021 coup d'état](/wiki/2021_Guinean_coup_d%27%C3%A9tat "2021 Guinean coup d'état") leader [Mamady Doumbouya](/wiki/Mamady_Doumbouya "Mamady Doumbouya") wins the presidency in a landslide.[[323]](#cite_note-325)
  + [December 2025 Kosovan parliamentary election](/wiki/December_2025_Kosovan_parliamentary_election "December 2025 Kosovan parliamentary election"): Incumbent Prime Minister [Albin Kurti](/wiki/Albin_Kurti "Albin Kurti")'s party [Vetëvendosje](/wiki/Vet%C3%ABvendosje "Vetëvendosje") wins a fourth consecutive victory, getting 49% of the vote.[[324]](#cite_note-326)
  + [2025 Iranian protests](/wiki/2025-2026_Iranian_protests "2025-2026 Iranian protests"): Major protests emerge in [Iran](/wiki/Iran "Iran") following an intense inflation spike that saw a severe depreciation in the [Iranian rial](/wiki/Iranian_rial "Iranian rial").[[325]](#cite_note-327) These protests are accompanied with demands for an end to the [Islamic republic](/wiki/Government_of_Iran "Government of Iran").
